research.label: Inference
research.title: Probabilistic inference
research.description: Graphical models, Bayesian inference, and scalable approximate inference algorithms.

research.label: Generation
research.title: Generative modeling
research.description: Diffusion models, score-based generative models, flow matching, and their theoretical foundations.

research.label: Reconstruction
research.title: Inverse problems
research.description: Compressed sensing, image restoration, and generative priors for inverse problems.

research.label: Language Models
research.title: Language models & agents
research.description: Diffusion language models, multimodal reasoning, parallel decoding, and agent methods.

publications.title: Visual-Redundancy-Controlled Parallel Decoding for Diffusion-Based Multimodal Large Language Models
publications.authors: Yulin Yuan, Hongshuo Zhao, Xiangming Meng
publications.summary: A training-free decoder uses token-to-image attention to select visually complementary positions and reduce redundancy during parallel diffusion decoding.

publications.title: Cluster-Level Attention-Guided Parallel Decoding for Masked Diffusion Language Models
publications.authors: Heqiang Qi, Wei Huang, Mingyuan Bai, Xiangming Meng
publications.summary: Confidence-induced token clusters and self-attention dependencies enable conflict-aware span-level updates for faster masked diffusion decoding.

publications.title: Diffusion Model Based Posterior Sampling for Noisy Linear Inverse Problems
publications.summary: A closed-form likelihood-score approximation that avoids backpropagation and accelerates posterior sampling for noisy linear inverse problems.

publications.title: QCS-SGM+: Improved Quantized Compressed Sensing with Score-Based Generative Models
publications.summary: Expectation propagation makes score-based quantized compressed sensing effective for general sensing matrices.

publications.title: Quantized Compressed Sensing with Score-Based Generative Models
publications.summary: A pretrained score prior and noise-perturbed pseudo-likelihood enable posterior sampling and uncertainty estimates from quantized measurements.

publications.title: On Model Selection Consistency of Lasso for High-Dimensional Ising Models
publications.authors: Xiangming Meng, Tomoyuki Obuchi, Yoshiyuki Kabashima
publications.summary: A rigorous account of model-selection consistency and sample complexity for Lasso in high-dimensional Ising models.

publications.title: Ising Model Selection Using ℓ₁-Regularized Linear Regression: A Statistical Mechanics Analysis
publications.authors: Xiangming Meng, Tomoyuki Obuchi, Yoshiyuki Kabashima
publications.summary: Replica analysis characterizes O(log N) sample complexity and finite-sample precision and recall for Ising graph recovery.

publications.title: Advanced NOMA Receivers From a Unified Variational Inference Perspective
publications.authors: Xiangming Meng, Lei Zhang, Chao Wang, Lei Wang, Yiqun Wu, Yan Chen, Wenjin Wang
publications.summary: A unified variational-inference view connects BP, EP, VEP, AMP, VAMP, and classical NOMA receivers.

publications.title: Training Binary Neural Networks using the Bayesian Learning Rule
publications.authors: Xiangming Meng, Roman Bachmann, Mohammad Emtiyaz Khan
publications.summary: A Bayesian learning rule yields a principled method for binary neural networks with uncertainty estimation and continual learning.

publications.title: A Unified Bayesian Inference Framework for Generalized Linear Models
publications.authors: Xiangming Meng, Sheng Wu, Jiang Zhu
publications.summary: Expectation propagation reduces generalized linear models to standard linear subproblems and unifies several message-passing algorithms.

principalInvestigator.name: Xiangming Meng
principalInvestigator.title: Assistant Professor · PhD Supervisor
principalInvestigator.titleZh: 研究员、助理教授、博士生导师
principalInvestigator.bio: His research interests include probabilistic graphical models, Bayesian inference, learning algorithms, and deep generative models for inverse problems, drawing on methods from information theory, signal processing, and statistical physics.

Xiangming Meng will serve as an Area Chair for ICLR 2027.

UST-SSM: Unified Spatio-Temporal State Space Models for Point Cloud Video Modeling was accepted to ICCV 2025.
SCSA: A Plug-and-Play Semantic Continuous-Sparse Attention for Arbitrary Semantic Style Transfer was selected as a CVPR 2025 Highlight.
